title.value: Momentum Extragradient is Optimal for Games with Cross-Shaped Spectrum
title.justification: The paper primarily focuses on analyzing the momentum extragradient method's optimality for games that have a Jacobian with a cross-shaped spectrum on the complex plane.
title.quote: Momentum Extragradient is Optimal for Games with Cross-Shaped Spectrum

extractions.description: This paper presents a polynomial-based analysis of the extragradient method with momentum for optimizing games with a cross-shaped spectrum on the complex plane. It shows that the extragradient method with momentum achieves accelerated convergence rate for games with this spectral structure, discusses the optimal hyperparameters, and details three different modes of convergence for various hyperparameter setups.
